ratingNote: 1–10 test-score rank from Public School Review, 2026-27 Fairfax elementary list (combined math and reading proficiency). Unrated boundaries stay gray.
salesNote: Most recent recorded sale on Single-family, Detached parcels only (townhouses and condos excluded), Fairfax market-sale points through 2025-01-01, $150k–$4M, assigned to the FCPS elementary boundary. Not a trailing-12-month MLS median.
commuteNote: Typical driving minutes from the school-boundary centroid to Merrifield (Gallows Rd) and Crystal City. Rush hour runs longer.
arlingtonNote: Arlington elementary boundaries from APS. Prices are the latest market sale on each single-family detached parcel in the county sales history, not a trailing-12-month MLS median.
